title: Move more charge across a voltage
hook: Change charge magnitude and predict electric-work magnitude.
misconception: electric-work magnitude stays fixed when charge magnitude doubles.
objective: Apply work magnitude = abs(qΔV) to compare electric-work magnitude when charge magnitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a fixed electric potential difference, work magnitude = abs(qΔV). When charge magnitude doubles, electric-work magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model work magnitude = abs(qΔV); scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a fixed electric potential difference, with a nonzero initial result. If charge magnitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on electric-work magnitude?
recall.why: Apply work magnitude = abs(qΔV) under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
